query_analysis.original_query: I am struggling to understand why the injection of water make-up suddenly decreases the desorption tower by a significant percentage ? is it related to the heat loss or more like an error in the DCS ?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Analyze the reasons for the significant decrease in desorption tower performance following the injection of water make-up. Determine whether the issue is due to heat loss, errors in the Distributed Control System (DCS), or other factors.

selected_agents.role: Root cause analysis of the desorption tower performance issue
Assessment of potential DCS errors and control system issues
Evaluation of heat loss impacts on desorption tower performance

communication_strategy.information_flow: Collaborative investigation integrating process data, control system analysis, and thermodynamic calculations
communication_strategy.collaboration_protocol: Integrated diagnostic approach with continuous data sharing and hypothesis testing

clarification_questions: When did you first notice the decrease in desorption tower performance?
Have there been any recent changes in the water make-up rate or composition?
Are there any alarms or unusual readings in the DCS?
Can you provide temperature and pressure data from the desorption tower before and after the issue occurred?
Have any maintenance activities or system modifications been performed recently?
